name: io.github.ocr-software/ocr-software-mcp
title: ocr-software.com OCR
description: Read PDFs and images with ocr-software.com: page count, job, text, Markdown, JSON, hOCR.

environmentVariables.name: OCR_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key, starts with ocr_. Never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: OCR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the service; for your own server e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.

environmentVariables.name: OCR_OUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where results are written. Default: ocr-results next to the document, else ~/Documents/ocr-results.

environmentVariables.name: OCR_ALLOWED_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional: read documents only from below this folder.
